## Clockwork Gunslinger (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
N Medium construct (clockwork)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +2 dodge, +5 natural)  
**hp** 69 (9d10+20)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +8, **Will** +3  
**Immune** construct traits  
**Weaknesses** vulnerable to electricity  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** slam +15 (1d6+7)  
**Ranged** pistol +12 (1d8/×4)  
**Special Attacks** captive time  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 16, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +14; **CMD** 29  
**Feats** Deadly Aim B, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
**SQ** difficult to create, integrated clockwork pistol, swift reactions, winding  


**Special Abilities**


**Captive Time (Ex)** Once per hour, a clockwork gunslinger can rotate its built-in hourglass as a swift action to instantly reload its pistol and gain the effects of haste for 1 round.
